facts.value: 8.7% offers of appointment (1,471 of 16,814 applications; Class of 2030, entering 2026)
SAT ERW 620-720, Math 620-730 (Class of 2030 middle 50%)
No ACT composite published; ACT Math 26-32 and English+Reading 52-67 (USNA-reported equivalents, Class of 2030)
64% of Class of 2030 were in the top 10% of their high school class; 90% varsity athletes
SAT, ACT or CLT required; tests taken before Jan 31 accepted; PSAT OK for preliminary application only; scores from accommodated tests not accepted
No ED or EA: rolling admissions; most candidates notified by April 15
Required: official interview with a Blue and Gold Officer (contact them as soon as you get a candidate number)
Not applicable: offers based on the Whole Person Multiple (academics, fitness, extracurriculars) plus a nomination
No major at entry; choose during plebe (first) year; most get first choice but Navy needs come first; at least 65% of Navy-commissioned grads must major in STEM
Eligibility: U.S. citizen, age 17-22 on July 1 of entry year, unmarried, not pregnant, no dependents

Nomination required (U.S. Representative, Senators, Vice President, or service-connected sources); apply to nominators right after the preliminary application; each office sets its own deadline, many notify in early-mid January
Medical: DoDMERB exam scheduled through DoDMETS after you become a candidate; waivers are considered automatically if you're competitive
Candidate Fitness Assessment required: 1-mile run, shuttle run, kneeling basketball throw, crunches, push-ups, pull-ups (or flexed-arm hang)
Service obligation: 5 years of active duty after graduation

Timeline: preliminary application (15-30 min, not savable) opens for rising seniors; a Summer Seminar application counts as the preliminary application; no new applications after Dec 31; full application due Jan 31, 2027
Gap: any essays or written statements are completed in the USNA candidate portal after the preliminary application and were not reviewed
Not applicable: no tuition or financial aid process. The Navy pays 100% of tuition, room and board, medical and dental care, in return for 5 years of active-duty service after graduation
